the exergy transfer rate of forced convective flow in a smooth duct subjected constant heat flux is a complex process and it is affected by the flow Reynolds number,the non-dimensional heat flux and the location of the cross-section in the duct.

the exergy transfer characteristics of the forced convective heat exergy transfer in a duct subjected to constant wall heat flux for fully-developed turbulent flow have been studied systematically by using the first and second law of thermodynamics and non-equilibrium thermodynamic theory, and the local and mean convectiv eexergy transfer coefficients, exergy fluxes, exergy transfer Nusselt numbers and the equation of exergy transfer rate have been defined and derived.

the local exergy transfer rate increases with the Reynolds number and non-dimensional heat flux, and the mean exergy transfer rate is a function of both the Reynolds number and the non-dimensional heat flux.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the exergy analysis of convective heat transfer in the fully developed turbulent flow in the duct subjected to constant wall heat flux,which is a significant extension of the existing studies of the exergy transfer in heat transfer process.
the exergy transfer characteristics in forced convective heat exchangers and it provides the basis for optimizing the design of the heat exchangers.
exergy transfer process of convective heat transfer in ducts and it is hoped to provide a reference for the study of exergy transfer process in other heat transfer fields.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the local and mean exergy transfer coefficient and Nusselt number are higher than that of energy transfer coefficient and energy Nusselt number,which indicates that exergy transfer process is a more efficient heat transfer process.
the convective exergy flux is not only related to the heat flux but also to the temperature difference and the fluid flow.
the convective exergy flux increases with Reynolds number and the convective exergic transfer coefficient is proportional to the square root of the convective heat flux.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the new generalized expressions of exergy transfer coefficients and exergy flux are more general than the corresponding ones of energy transfer,which is of great importance to the exergy analysis in heat transfer process.
the convective exergy-transfer coefficient and Nusselt number of exergy transfer are larger than that of energy transfer,and the exergy transfer rate is larger than the energy transfer rate.

the exergy analysis method can not only provide more accurate and detailed information on the heat transfer characteristics of a duct with constant wall heat flux,but also provide a more effective way for evaluating the heat transfer process and optimizing the design of the duct.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the exergy transfer process of forced convection in a smooth duct subjected constant heat flux can be analyzed in a more accurate and complete way than that of energy transfer.
the exergy transfer coefficient is not only related to Reynolds number,but also to the heat flux and different locations in the duct.
